definition: Lord of the Kula — the Kaula master, the one who recognizes spanda in himself. Kula = the Kaula school of Kashmir Śaivism (distinct from Trika). The kulendra is the practitioner who has realized spanda.

sources.claim: jayatyeṣa vīraḥ kulendraḥ (this hero, lord of the Kula, is victorious)

translations.note: 'Lord of the Kula' is literal; 'Kaula master' is the technical gloss.
